settings.content: The serum's bundle tiers, defined once. The buy box's bundle cards (Featured product → Bundle tier blocks pick a tier by number) and the cart drawer (one row per bundle, next-tier nudge, upgrade card) all read them, and snippets/bundle-tier-price.liquid prices them for both. The theme only displays these prices: the Kaching Bundles discount charges them at checkout, so keep the bottles and discounts here in step with the quantity breaks set up in Kaching.

settings.content: This store sells in USD and converts to the visitor's local currency through Shopify Markets. Many of those currencies share the $ symbol (USD, AUD, CAD, NZD, SGD), so the currency code is shown next to the cart totals a shopper commits to. The currency is the one for the storefront's current country (see Localization below), and the cart keeps it through to Shopify's checkout - a shopper can change it with the selector in the cart drawer or the footer.

Shopify only pre-selects a visitor's country automatically on Shopify Plus. On other plans every visitor starts in the primary market's default country and only sees their own currency after picking it in a country selector, or once checkout has their address. With this on, the theme asks Shopify which country it detects for the visitor and switches the storefront to it on their first visit, so the buy box, cart and checkout all start in the local currency. A visitor who picks a country in the cart or footer selector keeps that choice.

settings.label: Switch new visitors to their detected country
Send product pages to the home page

settings.content: Used by the Track your order page, the account order history and each order page. Some shipments are recorded without a tracking link (the carrier Shopify can't build a link for), so their tracking number opens this universal tracker instead, which follows the parcel across carriers to the last-mile service.

settings.label: Track your order page
settings.info: Create a page in Online Store → Pages with the "track-order" template and put its address here.

settings.label: Universal tracker link
settings.info: {number} is replaced by the tracking number.

settings.content: The store policies (refund, terms, privacy, contact) come from Settings → Policies, where Shopify's templates insert the store's own email and a link can show one address but open another. On the storefront's policy pages every email link opens this address and the store email in the text is replaced with it, so it is the only address a shopper sees there. Checkout shows the policies straight from Settings → Policies, so correct the addresses there as well. The footer, FAQ and Track your order sections have their own email text.

settings.label: Support email
settings.info: Leave empty to show the policy pages exactly as written in Settings → Policies.
